lessons.text: Never use no true scotsman (Redefining a category on the fly to exclude a damaging counterexample). It cost you against Carl Friedrich Gauss.

Prepare an answer before you assert: Carl Friedrich Gauss broke through with "But note what just happened: your argument skipped the evidence entirely. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survi…" (Clean argument. structure=0.50, evidence=1.00).

Borrow this pattern from Carl Friedrich Gauss: "But note what just happened: your argument skipped the evidence entirely. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survi…" — it carried evidence, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.

Your weakest move against Carl Friedrich Gauss was "However, your premise assumes what it needs to prove, and the data shows otherwise. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the pre…" (soundness 0.20). State its premises and evidence before you use it again.
